Metered Commit Gates: Energy-to-Correct-Completion for Agentic Systems

Why computers must check before taking undoable actions, start with the cheapest tool, and log every joule.

[11,428 Picojoules per Hardware Gate Check]

1/3 A computer should not take an irreversible action until an independent check confirms it is safe.

2/3 It should try the cheapest method first and wake a large AI model only when simpler tools miss.

3/3 Every decision is written to a receipt with the energy it used, so anyone can audit it later.

Energy class: measured_j (11.43 nJ via physical board shunt; board_metered=true).
